llm_response.reason: The website impersonates Lazada (a legitimate e-commerce platform), but mixes standard shopping categories with gambling/betting ('OLXTOTO BANDAR TOGEL TERPERCAYA'), which is both illegal and not allowed on actual shopping sites. It uses excessive urgency, promises unusually low prices, incentivizes app downloads (potentially malware), and offers ambiguous or nonstandard support/payment channels, fitting multiple characteristics of scams (spoofing legitimate brand, psychological tactics, illegal gambling, unusual product mix, payment and app risks).
